title: Vampire Vape Catapult Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Let Vampire Vape’s Catapult fling you away on a thrilling flavour adventure, with its captivating blend of rich blackcurrant and sun-kissed summer fruits with a frosty undertone. Catapult delights the senses with its exquisite taste, culminating in a delayed menthol burst that morphs the profile into a wickedly icy fruit medley. This tantalising e-liquid promises to elevate your vaping experience and transport you to a realm of exhilarating flavour sensations that you'll never want to leave. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
